name: Cash-Secured Put Roll Down and Out
summary: Management structure: close a threatened short put and reopen at a lower strike in a later expiry for a net credit, delaying or avoiding assignment.

legs.strike_rule: close the existing short put (now 0.55+ delta)
new strike <= old strike, at 0.25-0.30 delta in the new cycle
legs.dte_rule: next cycle, 30-45 DTE, at least 14 days beyond the old expiry

when_to_use: Short put delta >= 0.55 with DTE <= 21 and the system wants to avoid taking the shares now. Only valid if the underlying's thesis is intact.
typical_dte: execute at 14-21 DTE; new leg 30-45 DTE
entry_rules: Trigger: short put delta <= -0.55 OR spot < strike x 1.01, with DTE <= 21.
Execute as ONE multi-leg roll order (buy-to-close + sell-to-open).
Require NET CREDIT. If no lower strike pays a credit, roll out at the SAME strike for a credit; if that also fails, close the position and take the loss.
Require cash reserve for the new strike before submitting.
Do not roll into an expiry containing earnings.
Hard cap of 2 rolls per position.
management_rules: Track cumulative credits; the position must remain profitable at the new breakeven or the roll is just loss-deferral.
If total time in the position exceeds 90 days, close regardless.
If the underlying breaks its 200-day SMA by more than 5%, stop rolling and close.
exit_rules: If the roll cannot be filled by 15:30 ET on expiration day, buy back the short put outright - never carry it into expiration.
Standard extrinsic guard on the old leg until it is closed.
Kill the whole position if the unrealized loss exceeds 1.5% of account equity.
assignment_risk: The gap between closing and reopening is the exposure window - a combo order removes it. A deep ITM put being rolled may already be at early-exercise risk; if extrinsic < 0.05, close rather than roll.
buying_power: Cash reserve for the NEW strike (which is lower, so slightly less).
liquidity_needs: Both expiries liquid; roll net credit must exceed 10% of the roll's bid-ask cost.
common_mistakes: Rolling for a debit; rolling forever and turning a defined bad trade into an unbounded time commitment; rolling without re-checking that the cash reserve exists.
zero_dte_notes: Do not roll 0DTE puts - close them.
family: Stock/ETF Shares Combined With Options (covered writes, protective hedges, collars, synthetics, repairs, conversions)
